ayahs.text: Alif. Lam. Ra. THESE ARE MESSAGES of revelation -of a discourse clear in itself and clearly showing the truth.
ayahs.arabic: بِسْمِ ٱللَّهِ ٱلرَّحْمَٰنِ ٱلرَّحِيمِ الٓر ۚ تِلْكَ ءَايَٰتُ ٱلْكِتَٰبِ وَقُرْءَانٍۢ مُّبِينٍۢ

ayahs.text: And it will come to pass that those who are [now] bent on denying this truth will wish that they had surrendered themselves to God [in their life time].
ayahs.arabic: رُّبَمَا يَوَدُّ ٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا۟ لَوْ كَانُوا۟ مُسْلِمِينَ

ayahs.text: Leave them alone; let them eat and enjoy themselves the while the hope [of vain delights] be guiles them: for in time they will come to know [the truth].
ayahs.arabic: ذَرْهُمْ يَأْكُلُوا۟ وَيَتَمَتَّعُوا۟ وَيُلْهِهِمُ ٱلْأَمَلُ ۖ فَسَوْفَ يَعْلَمُونَ

ayahs.text: And never have We destroyed any community [for its wrongdoing] unless a divine writ had (previously] been made known to it;
ayahs.arabic: وَمَآ أَهْلَكْنَا مِن قَرْيَةٍ إِلَّا وَلَهَا كِتَابٌۭ مَّعْلُومٌۭ

ayahs.text: [but remember that] no community can ever forestall [the end of] its term - and neither can they delay [it].
ayahs.arabic: مَّا تَسْبِقُ مِنْ أُمَّةٍ أَجَلَهَا وَمَا يَسْتَـْٔخِرُونَ

ayahs.text: And yet, they [who deny the truth] say: "O thou unto whom this reminder has [allegedly] been bestowed from on high: verily, thou art mad!
ayahs.arabic: وَقَالُوا۟ يَٰٓأَيُّهَا ٱلَّذِى نُزِّلَ عَلَيْهِ ٱلذِّكْرُ إِنَّكَ لَمَجْنُونٌۭ

ayahs.text: Why dost thou not bring before us angels, if thou art a man of truth?
ayahs.arabic: لَّوْ مَا تَأْتِينَا بِٱلْمَلَٰٓئِكَةِ إِن كُنتَ مِنَ ٱلصَّٰدِقِينَ

ayahs.text: [Yet] We never send down angels otherwise than in accordance with the [demands of] truth; and [were the angels to appear now,] lo! they [who reject this divine writ] would have no further respite!
ayahs.arabic: مَا نُنَزِّلُ ٱلْمَلَٰٓئِكَةَ إِلَّا بِٱلْحَقِّ وَمَا كَانُوٓا۟ إِذًۭا مُّنظَرِينَ

ayahs.text: Behold, it is We Ourselves who have bestowed from on high, step by step, this reminder? and, behold, it is We who shall truly guard it [from all corruption].
ayahs.arabic: إِنَّا نَحْنُ نَزَّلْنَا ٱلذِّكْرَ وَإِنَّا لَهُۥ لَحَٰفِظُونَ

ayahs.text: AND, INDEED, [O Prophet,] even before thy time did We send [Our apostles] unto communities of old -
ayahs.arabic: وَلَقَدْ أَرْسَلْنَا مِن قَبْلِكَ فِى شِيَعِ ٱلْأَوَّلِينَ

ayahs.text: and never yet came an apostle to them without their deriding him.
ayahs.arabic: وَمَا يَأْتِيهِم مِّن رَّسُولٍ إِلَّا كَانُوا۟ بِهِۦ يَسْتَهْزِءُونَ

ayahs.text: Even so do We [now] cause this [scorn of Our message] to pervade the hearts of those who are lost in sin,
ayahs.arabic: كَذَٰلِكَ نَسْلُكُهُۥ فِى قُلُوبِ ٱلْمُجْرِمِينَ

ayahs.text: who do not believe in it, although the way which those [evildoers] of olden times had to go has long been within their ken.
ayahs.arabic: لَا يُؤْمِنُونَ بِهِۦ ۖ وَقَدْ خَلَتْ سُنَّةُ ٱلْأَوَّلِينَ

ayahs.text: Yet even had We opened to them a gateway to heaven and they had ascended, on and on, up to it,
ayahs.arabic: وَلَوْ فَتَحْنَا عَلَيْهِم بَابًۭا مِّنَ ٱلسَّمَآءِ فَظَلُّوا۟ فِيهِ يَعْرُجُونَ

ayahs.text: they would surely have said, "It is only our eyes that are spellbound! Nay, we have been bewitched!,
ayahs.arabic: لَقَالُوٓا۟ إِنَّمَا سُكِّرَتْ أَبْصَٰرُنَا بَلْ نَحْنُ قَوْمٌۭ مَّسْحُورُونَ

ayahs.text: AND, INDEED, We have set up in the heavens great constellations, and endowed them with beauty for all to behold;
ayahs.arabic: وَلَقَدْ جَعَلْنَا فِى ٱلسَّمَآءِ بُرُوجًۭا وَزَيَّنَّٰهَا لِلنَّٰظِرِينَ

ayahs.text: and We have made them secure against every satanic force accursed -
ayahs.arabic: وَحَفِظْنَٰهَا مِن كُلِّ شَيْطَٰنٍۢ رَّجِيمٍ

ayahs.text: so that anyone who seeks to learn [the unknowable] by stealth is pursued by a flame clear to see.
ayahs.arabic: إِلَّا مَنِ ٱسْتَرَقَ ٱلسَّمْعَ فَأَتْبَعَهُۥ شِهَابٌۭ مُّبِينٌۭ

ayahs.text: And the earth -We have spread it out wide, and placed on it mountains firm, and caused [life] of every kind to grow on it in a balanced manner,
ayahs.arabic: وَٱلْأَرْضَ مَدَدْنَٰهَا وَأَلْقَيْنَا فِيهَا رَوَٰسِىَ وَأَنۢبَتْنَا فِيهَا مِن كُلِّ شَىْءٍۢ مَّوْزُونٍۢ

ayahs.text: and provided thereon means of livelihood for you [O men] as well as for all [living beings] whose sustenance does not depend on you.
ayahs.arabic: وَجَعَلْنَا لَكُمْ فِيهَا مَعَٰيِشَ وَمَن لَّسْتُمْ لَهُۥ بِرَٰزِقِينَ

ayahs.text: For, no single thing exists that does not have its source with Us; and nought do We bestow from on high unless it be in accordance with a measure well-defined.
ayahs.arabic: وَإِن مِّن شَىْءٍ إِلَّا عِندَنَا خَزَآئِنُهُۥ وَمَا نُنَزِّلُهُۥٓ إِلَّا بِقَدَرٍۢ مَّعْلُومٍۢ

ayahs.text: And We let loose the winds to fertilize [plants] and We send down water from the skies and let you drink thereof: and it is not you who dispose of its source-
ayahs.arabic: وَأَرْسَلْنَا ٱلرِّيَٰحَ لَوَٰقِحَ فَأَنزَلْنَا مِنَ ٱلسَّمَآءِ مَآءًۭ فَأَسْقَيْنَٰكُمُوهُ وَمَآ أَنتُمْ لَهُۥ بِخَٰزِنِينَ

ayahs.text: for, behold, it is We-We alone -who grant life and deal death, and it is We alone who shall remain after all else will have passed away!
ayahs.arabic: وَإِنَّا لَنَحْنُ نُحْىِۦ وَنُمِيتُ وَنَحْنُ ٱلْوَٰرِثُونَ

ayahs.text: And well do We know [the hearts and deeds of all human beings - both] those who lived before you and those who will come after you;
ayahs.arabic: وَلَقَدْ عَلِمْنَا ٱلْمُسْتَقْدِمِينَ مِنكُمْ وَلَقَدْ عَلِمْنَا ٱلْمُسْتَـْٔخِرِينَ

ayahs.text: and, behold, it is thy Sustainer who will gather them all together [on Judgment Day]: verily, He is wise, all-knowing!
ayahs.arabic: وَإِنَّ رَبَّكَ هُوَ يَحْشُرُهُمْ ۚ إِنَّهُۥ حَكِيمٌ عَلِيمٌۭ

ayahs.text: AND, INDEED, We have created man out of sounding clay, out of dark-slime transmuted
ayahs.arabic: وَلَقَدْ خَلَقْنَا ٱلْإِنسَٰنَ مِن صَلْصَٰلٍۢ مِّنْ حَمَإٍۢ مَّسْنُونٍۢ

ayahs.text: whereas the invisible beings We had created, [long] before that, out of the fire of scorching winds.
ayahs.arabic: وَٱلْجَآنَّ خَلَقْنَٰهُ مِن قَبْلُ مِن نَّارِ ٱلسَّمُومِ

ayahs.text: And lo! Thy Sustainer said unto the angels: "Behold, I am about to create mortal man out of sounding clay, out of dark slime transmuted;
ayahs.arabic: وَإِذْ قَالَ رَبُّكَ لِلْمَلَٰٓئِكَةِ إِنِّى خَٰلِقٌۢ بَشَرًۭا مِّن صَلْصَٰلٍۢ مِّنْ حَمَإٍۢ مَّسْنُونٍۢ

ayahs.text: and when I have formed him fully and breathed into him of My spirit, fall down before him in prostration!
ayahs.arabic: فَإِذَا سَوَّيْتُهُۥ وَنَفَخْتُ فِيهِ مِن رُّوحِى فَقَعُوا۟ لَهُۥ سَٰجِدِينَ

ayahs.text: Thereupon the angels prostrated themselves, all of them together,
ayahs.arabic: فَسَجَدَ ٱلْمَلَٰٓئِكَةُ كُلُّهُمْ أَجْمَعُونَ

ayahs.text: save Iblis: he refused to be among those who prostrated themselves.
ayahs.arabic: إِلَّآ إِبْلِيسَ أَبَىٰٓ أَن يَكُونَ مَعَ ٱلسَّٰجِدِينَ

ayahs.text: Said He: "O Iblis! What is thy reason for not being among those who have prostrated themselves?"
ayahs.arabic: قَالَ يَٰٓإِبْلِيسُ مَا لَكَ أَلَّا تَكُونَ مَعَ ٱلسَّٰجِدِينَ

ayahs.text: [Iblis] replied: "It is not for me to prostrate myself before mortal man whom Thou hast created out of sounding clay, out of dark slime transmuted!"
ayahs.arabic: قَالَ لَمْ أَكُن لِّأَسْجُدَ لِبَشَرٍ خَلَقْتَهُۥ مِن صَلْصَٰلٍۢ مِّنْ حَمَإٍۢ مَّسْنُونٍۢ

ayahs.text: Said He: "Go forth, then, from this [angelic state]: for, behold, thou art [henceforth] accursed,
ayahs.arabic: قَالَ فَٱخْرُجْ مِنْهَا فَإِنَّكَ رَجِيمٌۭ

ayahs.text: and [My] rejection shall be thy due until the Day of Judgment!"
ayahs.arabic: وَإِنَّ عَلَيْكَ ٱللَّعْنَةَ إِلَىٰ يَوْمِ ٱلدِّينِ

ayahs.text: Said [Iblis]: "Then, O my Sustainer, grant me a respite till the Day when all shall be raised from the dead!"
ayahs.arabic: قَالَ رَبِّ فَأَنظِرْنِىٓ إِلَىٰ يَوْمِ يُبْعَثُونَ

ayahs.text: Answered He: "Verily, so be it: thou shalt be among those who are granted respite
ayahs.arabic: قَالَ فَإِنَّكَ مِنَ ٱلْمُنظَرِينَ

ayahs.text: till the Day the time whereof is known [to Me alone]."
ayahs.arabic: إِلَىٰ يَوْمِ ٱلْوَقْتِ ٱلْمَعْلُومِ

ayahs.text: [Whereupon Iblis] said: "O my Sustainer! Since Thou hast thwarted me, I shall indeed make [all that is evil] on earth seem goodly to them, and shall most certainly beguile them-into grievous error -
ayahs.arabic: قَالَ رَبِّ بِمَآ أَغْوَيْتَنِى لَأُزَيِّنَنَّ لَهُمْ فِى ٱلْأَرْضِ وَلَأُغْوِيَنَّهُمْ أَجْمَعِينَ

ayahs.text: [all] save such of them as are truly Thy servants!"
ayahs.arabic: إِلَّا عِبَادَكَ مِنْهُمُ ٱلْمُخْلَصِينَ

ayahs.text: Said He: "This is, with Me. a straight way:
ayahs.arabic: قَالَ هَٰذَا صِرَٰطٌ عَلَىَّ مُسْتَقِيمٌ

ayahs.text: verily, thou shalt have no power over My creatures- unless it be such as are [already] lost in grievous error and follow thee [of their own will]:
ayahs.arabic: إِنَّ عِبَادِى لَيْسَ لَكَ عَلَيْهِمْ سُلْطَٰنٌ إِلَّا مَنِ ٱتَّبَعَكَ مِنَ ٱلْغَاوِينَ

ayahs.text: and for all such, behold, hell is the promised goal.
ayahs.arabic: وَإِنَّ جَهَنَّمَ لَمَوْعِدُهُمْ أَجْمَعِينَ

ayahs.text: with seven gates leading into it, each gate receiving its allotted share of sinners. -
ayahs.arabic: لَهَا سَبْعَةُ أَبْوَٰبٍۢ لِّكُلِّ بَابٍۢ مِّنْهُمْ جُزْءٌۭ مَّقْسُومٌ

ayahs.text: VERILY, those who are conscious of God [shall find themselves in the hereafter] amidst gardens and springs,
ayahs.arabic: إِنَّ ٱلْمُتَّقِينَ فِى جَنَّٰتٍۢ وَعُيُونٍ

ayahs.text: [having been received with the greeting,] "Enter here in peace, secure!"
ayahs.arabic: ٱدْخُلُوهَا بِسَلَٰمٍ ءَامِنِينَ

ayahs.text: And [by then] We shall have removed whatever unworthy thoughts or feelings may have been [lingering] in their breasts, [and they shall rest] as brethren, facing one another [in love] upon thrones of happiness.
ayahs.arabic: وَنَزَعْنَا مَا فِى صُدُورِهِم مِّنْ غِلٍّ إِخْوَٰنًا عَلَىٰ سُرُرٍۢ مُّتَقَٰبِلِينَ

ayahs.text: No weariness shall ever touch them in this [state of bliss], and never shall they have to forgo it.
ayahs.arabic: لَا يَمَسُّهُمْ فِيهَا نَصَبٌۭ وَمَا هُم مِّنْهَا بِمُخْرَجِينَ

ayahs.text: Tell My servants that I - I alone - am truly forgiving, a true dispenser of grace;
ayahs.arabic: ۞ نَبِّئْ عِبَادِىٓ أَنِّىٓ أَنَا ٱلْغَفُورُ ٱلرَّحِيمُ

ayahs.text: and [also,] that the suffering which I shall impose [on sinners] will indeed be a suffering most grievous.
ayahs.arabic: وَأَنَّ عَذَابِى هُوَ ٱلْعَذَابُ ٱلْأَلِيمُ

ayahs.text: AND TELL THEM [once again] about Abraham's guests -
ayahs.arabic: وَنَبِّئْهُمْ عَن ضَيْفِ إِبْرَٰهِيمَ

ayahs.text: [how,] when they presented themselves before him and bade him peace, he answered: "Behold, we are afraid of you!"
ayahs.arabic: إِذْ دَخَلُوا۟ عَلَيْهِ فَقَالُوا۟ سَلَٰمًۭا قَالَ إِنَّا مِنكُمْ وَجِلُونَ

ayahs.text: Said they: "Fear not! Behold, we bring thee the glad tiding of [the birth of] a son who will be endowed with deep knowledge."
ayahs.arabic: قَالُوا۟ لَا تَوْجَلْ إِنَّا نُبَشِّرُكَ بِغُلَٰمٍ عَلِيمٍۢ

ayahs.text: Said he: "Do you give me this glad tiding despite the fact that old age has overtaken me? Of what [strange thing], then, are you giving me a tiding!"
ayahs.arabic: قَالَ أَبَشَّرْتُمُونِى عَلَىٰٓ أَن مَّسَّنِىَ ٱلْكِبَرُ فَبِمَ تُبَشِّرُونَ

ayahs.text: They answered: "We have given thee the glad tiding of something that is bound to come true. - so be not of those who abandon hope!"
ayahs.arabic: قَالُوا۟ بَشَّرْنَٰكَ بِٱلْحَقِّ فَلَا تَكُن مِّنَ ٱلْقَٰنِطِينَ

ayahs.text: [Abraham] exclaimed: "And who-other than those who have utterly lost their way-could ever abandon the hope of his Sustainer's grace?"
ayahs.arabic: قَالَ وَمَن يَقْنَطُ مِن رَّحْمَةِ رَبِّهِۦٓ إِلَّا ٱلضَّآلُّونَ

ayahs.text: He added: "And what [else] may you have in view, O you [heavenly] messengers?"
ayahs.arabic: قَالَ فَمَا خَطْبُكُمْ أَيُّهَا ٱلْمُرْسَلُونَ

ayahs.text: They answered: "We are sent to people lost in sin [who are to be destroyed],
ayahs.arabic: قَالُوٓا۟ إِنَّآ أُرْسِلْنَآ إِلَىٰ قَوْمٍۢ مُّجْرِمِينَ

ayahs.text: barring Lot's household, all of whom, behold, we shall save -
ayahs.arabic: إِلَّآ ءَالَ لُوطٍ إِنَّا لَمُنَجُّوهُمْ أَجْمَعِينَ

ayahs.text: excepting only his wife, [of whom God says,] `We have ordained [that], behold, she should be among those who stay behind!'
ayahs.arabic: إِلَّا ٱمْرَأَتَهُۥ قَدَّرْنَآ ۙ إِنَّهَا لَمِنَ ٱلْغَٰبِرِينَ

ayahs.text: AND WHEN the messengers [of God] came to the house of Lot,
ayahs.arabic: فَلَمَّا جَآءَ ءَالَ لُوطٍ ٱلْمُرْسَلُونَ

ayahs.text: he said: "Behold, you are people unknown [here]!"
ayahs.arabic: قَالَ إِنَّكُمْ قَوْمٌۭ مُّنكَرُونَ

ayahs.text: They answered: "Nay, but we have come unto thee with [the announcement of] something that they [who are given to evil] have always been wont to call in question,
ayahs.arabic: قَالُوا۟ بَلْ جِئْنَٰكَ بِمَا كَانُوا۟ فِيهِ يَمْتَرُونَ

ayahs.text: and we are bringing thee the certainty [of its fulfilment]: for, behold, we are speaking the truth indeed.
ayahs.arabic: وَأَتَيْنَٰكَ بِٱلْحَقِّ وَإِنَّا لَصَٰدِقُونَ

ayahs.text: Go, then., with thy household while it is yet night, with thyself following them in the rear; and let none of you look back, but proceed whither you are bidden."
ayahs.arabic: فَأَسْرِ بِأَهْلِكَ بِقِطْعٍۢ مِّنَ ٱلَّيْلِ وَٱتَّبِعْ أَدْبَٰرَهُمْ وَلَا يَلْتَفِتْ مِنكُمْ أَحَدٌۭ وَٱمْضُوا۟ حَيْثُ تُؤْمَرُونَ

ayahs.text: And [through Our messengers] We revealed unto him this decree: "The last remnant of those [sinners] shall be wiped out" in the morn."
ayahs.arabic: وَقَضَيْنَآ إِلَيْهِ ذَٰلِكَ ٱلْأَمْرَ أَنَّ دَابِرَ هَٰٓؤُلَآءِ مَقْطُوعٌۭ مُّصْبِحِينَ

ayahs.text: And the people of the city came [unto Lot], rejoicing at the glad tiding.
ayahs.arabic: وَجَآءَ أَهْلُ ٱلْمَدِينَةِ يَسْتَبْشِرُونَ

ayahs.text: Exclaimed [Lot]: "Behold, these are my guests: so put me not to shame,
ayahs.arabic: قَالَ إِنَّ هَٰٓؤُلَآءِ ضَيْفِى فَلَا تَفْضَحُونِ

ayahs.text: but be conscious of God and disgrace me not!"
ayahs.arabic: وَٱتَّقُوا۟ ٱللَّهَ وَلَا تُخْزُونِ

ayahs.text: They answered: "Have we not forbidden thee [to offer protection] to any kind of people?"
ayahs.arabic: قَالُوٓا۟ أَوَلَمْ نَنْهَكَ عَنِ ٱلْعَٰلَمِينَ

ayahs.text: [Lot] said: "[Take instead] these daughters of mine, if you must do [whatever you intend to do]!"
ayahs.arabic: قَالَ هَٰٓؤُلَآءِ بَنَاتِىٓ إِن كُنتُمْ فَٰعِلِينَ

ayahs.text: [But the angels spoke thus:] "As thou livest, [O Lot, they will not listen to thee:] behold, in their delirium [of lust] they are but blindly stumbling to and fro!"
ayahs.arabic: لَعَمْرُكَ إِنَّهُمْ لَفِى سَكْرَتِهِمْ يَعْمَهُونَ

ayahs.text: And thereupon the blast [of Our punishment] overtook them at the time of sunrise,
ayahs.arabic: فَأَخَذَتْهُمُ ٱلصَّيْحَةُ مُشْرِقِينَ

ayahs.text: and We turned those [sinful towns} upside down, and rained down upon them stone-hard blows of chastisement pre-ordained.
ayahs.arabic: فَجَعَلْنَا عَٰلِيَهَا سَافِلَهَا وَأَمْطَرْنَا عَلَيْهِمْ حِجَارَةًۭ مِّن سِجِّيلٍ

ayahs.text: Verily, in all this there are messages indeed for those who can read the signs:
ayahs.arabic: إِنَّ فِى ذَٰلِكَ لَءَايَٰتٍۢ لِّلْمُتَوَسِّمِينَ

ayahs.text: for, behold, those [towns] stood by a road that still exists.
ayahs.arabic: وَإِنَّهَا لَبِسَبِيلٍۢ مُّقِيمٍ

ayahs.text: Verily, herein lies a message indeed for all who believe [in God].
ayahs.arabic: إِنَّ فِى ذَٰلِكَ لَءَايَةًۭ لِّلْمُؤْمِنِينَ

ayahs.text: AND THE DWELLERS of the wooded dales [of Madyan, too,] were inveterate evildoers,
ayahs.arabic: وَإِن كَانَ أَصْحَٰبُ ٱلْأَيْكَةِ لَظَٰلِمِينَ

ayahs.text: and so We inflicted Our retribution on them. And, behold, both these [sinful communities] lived by a highway, [to this day] plain to see
ayahs.arabic: فَٱنتَقَمْنَا مِنْهُمْ وَإِنَّهُمَا لَبِإِمَامٍۢ مُّبِينٍۢ

ayahs.text: AND, [likewise,] indeed, the people of Al-Hijr gave the lie to [Our] message-bearers:
ayahs.arabic: وَلَقَدْ كَذَّبَ أَصْحَٰبُ ٱلْحِجْرِ ٱلْمُرْسَلِينَ

ayahs.text: for We did vouchsafe them Our messages, but they obstinately turned their backs upon them-
ayahs.arabic: وَءَاتَيْنَٰهُمْ ءَايَٰتِنَا فَكَانُوا۟ عَنْهَا مُعْرِضِينَ

ayahs.text: notwithstanding that they had been wont [to enjoy Our blessings and] to hew out dwellings from the mountains, [wherein they could live] in security
ayahs.arabic: وَكَانُوا۟ يَنْحِتُونَ مِنَ ٱلْجِبَالِ بُيُوتًا ءَامِنِينَ

ayahs.text: and so the blast [of Our punishment] overtook them at early morn,
ayahs.arabic: فَأَخَذَتْهُمُ ٱلصَّيْحَةُ مُصْبِحِينَ

ayahs.text: and of no avail to them was all [the power] that they had acquired.
ayahs.arabic: فَمَآ أَغْنَىٰ عَنْهُم مَّا كَانُوا۟ يَكْسِبُونَ

ayahs.text: AND [remember:] We have not created the heavens and the earth and all that is between them without [an inner] truth; but, behold, the Hour [when this will become clear to all] is indeed yet to come. Hence, forgive [men's failings] with fair forbearance:
ayahs.arabic: وَمَا خَلَقْنَا ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ وَٱلْأَرْضَ وَمَا بَيْنَهُمَآ إِلَّا بِٱلْحَقِّ ۗ وَإِنَّ ٱلسَّاعَةَ لَءَاتِيَةٌۭ ۖ فَٱصْفَحِ ٱلصَّفْحَ ٱلْجَمِيلَ

ayahs.text: verily, thy Sustainer is the all-knowing Creator of all things!
ayahs.arabic: إِنَّ رَبَّكَ هُوَ ٱلْخَلَّٰقُ ٱلْعَلِيمُ

ayahs.text: AND, INDEED, We have bestowed upon thee seven of the oft repeated [verses], and [have, thus, laid open before thee] this sublime Qur'an:
ayahs.arabic: وَلَقَدْ ءَاتَيْنَٰكَ سَبْعًۭا مِّنَ ٱلْمَثَانِى وَٱلْقُرْءَانَ ٱلْعَظِيمَ

ayahs.text: [so] turn, not thine eyes [longingly] towards the worldly benefits which We have granted unto some of those [that deny the truth]. And neither grieve over those [who refuse to heed thee], but spread the wings of thy tenderness over the believers,
ayahs.arabic: لَا تَمُدَّنَّ عَيْنَيْكَ إِلَىٰ مَا مَتَّعْنَا بِهِۦٓ أَزْوَٰجًۭا مِّنْهُمْ وَلَا تَحْزَنْ عَلَيْهِمْ وَٱخْفِضْ جَنَاحَكَ لِلْمُؤْمِنِينَ

ayahs.text: and say: "Behold, I am indeed the plain warner [promised by God]!
ayahs.arabic: وَقُلْ إِنِّىٓ أَنَا ٱلنَّذِيرُ ٱلْمُبِينُ

ayahs.text: [For, thou art the bearer of a divine writ] such as We have bestowed from on high upon those who [afterwards] broke it up into parts,
ayahs.arabic: كَمَآ أَنزَلْنَا عَلَى ٱلْمُقْتَسِمِينَ

ayahs.text: [and] who [now] declare this Qur'an to be [a tissue of] falsehoods!
ayahs.arabic: ٱلَّذِينَ جَعَلُوا۟ ٱلْقُرْءَانَ عِضِينَ

ayahs.text: But, by thy Sustainer! [On the Day of Judgment] We shall indeed call them to account, one and all,
ayahs.arabic: فَوَرَبِّكَ لَنَسْـَٔلَنَّهُمْ أَجْمَعِينَ

ayahs.text: for whatever they have done!
ayahs.arabic: عَمَّا كَانُوا۟ يَعْمَلُونَ

ayahs.text: Hence, proclaim openly all that thou hast been bidden [to say], and leave alone all those who ascribe divinity to aught beside God:
ayahs.arabic: فَٱصْدَعْ بِمَا تُؤْمَرُ وَأَعْرِضْ عَنِ ٱلْمُشْرِكِينَ

ayahs.text: verily, We shall suffice thee against all who [now] deride [this message - all]
ayahs.arabic: إِنَّا كَفَيْنَٰكَ ٱلْمُسْتَهْزِءِينَ

ayahs.text: who assert that there are, side by side with God, other divine powers as well: for in time they will come to know [the truth].
ayahs.arabic: ٱلَّذِينَ يَجْعَلُونَ مَعَ ٱللَّهِ إِلَٰهًا ءَاخَرَ ۚ فَسَوْفَ يَعْلَمُونَ

ayahs.text: And well do We know that thy bosom is constricted by the [blasphemous] things that they say:
ayahs.arabic: وَلَقَدْ نَعْلَمُ أَنَّكَ يَضِيقُ صَدْرُكَ بِمَا يَقُولُونَ

ayahs.text: but extol thou thy Sustainer's limitless glory and praise Him, and be of those who prostrate themselves [before Him] in adoration,
ayahs.arabic: فَسَبِّحْ بِحَمْدِ رَبِّكَ وَكُن مِّنَ ٱلسَّٰجِدِينَ

ayahs.text: and worship thy Sustainer till death comes to thee.
ayahs.arabic: وَٱعْبُدْ رَبَّكَ حَتَّىٰ يَأْتِيَكَ ٱلْيَقِينُ
